title: Outpatient Management of Patients With Exacerbation of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
brief_summary: Patients admitted to the hospital with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease are evaluated with regard to early follow-up by a specialized nurse in the home after discharge.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Admission for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other severe acute or chronic diseases
